ORDER BY NACD

mapper.insert: /* 국가정보관리 (8000) - 등록,수정 */ /* AdminNationMapper.insert */ MERGE INTO CSPD115TI A USING DUAL ON (A.NACD = UPPER(#{nacd}) AND A.ENG_NL_NM = UPPER(#{engNlNm})) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.KORL_NL_NM = #{korlNlNm}, A.LST_DB_CHG_ID = #{lstDbChgId}, A.TRN_LOG_SRNO = #{trnLogSrno}, A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM = , A.RPRS_CD_YN = NVL(#{rprsCdYn},'N') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (A.NACD, A.NUTP_NACD, A.KORL_NL_NM, A.ENG_NL_NM, A.KORL_NL_ABRV_NM, A.ENG_NL_ABRV_NM, A.TRN_LOG_SRNO, A.LST_DB_CHG_ID, A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM, A.RPRS_CD_YN) VALUES (UPPER(#{nacd}), #{nutpNacd}, #{korlNlNm}, UPPER(#{engNlNm}), #{korlNlAbrvNm}, UPPER(#{engNlAbrvNm}), #{trnLogSrno}, #{lstDbChgId}, , #{rprsCdYn})
mapper.update: /* 국가정보관리 (8000) - 등록수정시 대표이름 초기화 */ /* AdminNationMapper.updateInitRprsCdYn */ UPDATE CSPD115TI SET RPRS_CD_YN = 'N', TRN_LOG_SRNO = #{trnLogSrno}, LST_DB_CHG_ID = #{lstDbChgId}, LST_DB_CHG_DTM = WHERE NACD = UPPER(#{nacd})
